text:
Priya Patel: Quick sync—want to align on exposing tenant SLA profiles + dynamic CB thresholds in the console and API. Thinking: per-tenant SLO targets (latency p95, availability) drive routing policy and automatic model-variant fallback chains.
Alex Chen: +1. We need the API first (sloProfiles) so infra teams can script rollouts. Console is later.
Jonah Li: How would CB thresholds be derived? static numbers or sliding windows?
Priya Patel: proposal: default profile -> baseline thresholds; then adaptive overrides per tenant based on historical p50/p95/p99. Admins can pin hard limits.
Sara Gomez: I'm worried about signal noise. If we adapt from p95 spikes, we might flip routing too often. Need hysteresis and cooldown. :thinking_face:
Marco Ruiz: agree. Circuit-breaker states: CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN. Open if error rate > x or p95 above threshold for T consecutive windows. Cooldown with exponential backoff.
Priya Patel: example profile sketch (API payload):
```
{
  "profile_name": "enterprise_gold",
  "targets": {"latency_p95_ms": 150, "availability_pct": 99.9},
  "fallback_chain": ["gptx-16q", "gptx-8q", "gptx-8q-fast"],
  "cb_policy": {"window_sec": 60, "consecutive_windows": 3, "error_pct_open": 5, "latency_p95_open_ms": 300, "cooldown_sec": 120}
}
```
Alex Chen: Nice. Also want cost/rank weight for fallback variants (quality vs cost). Could be weights or hard order.
Jonah Li: For routing: evaluate SLO profile before model selection. If CLOSED and under SLO -> route to primary. If OPEN -> follow fallback_chain with per-variant latency budgets.
Sara Gomez: UX: Console should show a simulated traffic slider + predicted p95/cost for each variant given batch sizes. Also live state (OPEN/HALF_OPEN).
Priya Patel: telemetry: need p50/p95/p99, error %, reject rate, queued_requests, avg_kv_cache_hit, and per-variant token cost. Time series must be at 10s granularity for quick detection.
Marco Ruiz: ops-bot can emit CB transitions: `CB_OPEN tenant=acme profile=enterprise_gold reason=latency_p95` and include recent window stats. infra-bot: can we plumb that into Slack alerts?
infra-bot: yes — we already have a webhook for cb-events. I can add tenant and profile tags.
Alex Chen: API ergonomics: POST /sloProfiles/{tenant} to set profile, GET to preview effective thresholds (merge defaults + adaptive). Need a dry-run endpoint: /sloProfiles/{tenant}/simulate with traffic pattern.
Jonah Li: Simulation should allow different regions. We must respect regional fallbacks (some variants not deployed in APAC). Fallback chain must be validated against region compatibility.
Sara Gomez: Also quotas: a tenant may hit quota even if SLO allows it. We need the route decision to consider both SLO state and available quota. If quota exhausted -> soft-fallback (throttle tokens or degrade to embeddings-only path).
Priya Patel: Good point. Decision order: 1) hard SLA blockers (quota/security), 2) SLO-driven routing/Circuit-breaker, 3) cost-preference. Log every decision with reason.
Alex Chen: For rollout UX: make canary toggles on profile changes with percent traffic and auto rollback if CB opens or p95 regresses > delta. Console should show expected cost delta and SLO risk.
Marco Ruiz: Implementation notes for runtime: maintain per-tenant sliding windows (60s buckets x 10 windows). Compute p95 from reservoir summaries. Keep memory bounded.
Jonah Li: Edge-case: short bursts from cron jobs can skew stats. Add request-weighting or ignore bursts from known infra keys.
Sara Gomez: Observability: expose a dashboard with tenant-level summary and a heatmap of CB state by region. Also attach last 10 reasons for CB_OPEN.
Priya Patel: Security: profile changes must be RBAC-guarded. Also audit log for every automatic adaptive change.
Alex Chen: API contract question: should fallback_chain include variant attributes or only IDs? If only IDs, console must resolve attributes (latency_est, cost_est).
Priya Patel: prefer IDs in profile; runtime uses model catalog to enrich. Keep payload small.
Marco Ruiz: Ops failure modes: when runtime fails to fetch profile, fallback to tenant-default or global-default with note in logs. Avoid cascading CB opens from control-plane flaps.
Jonah Li: Testing: unit tests for policy merger, simulation harness, e2e with synthetic traffic. Also chaos test: kill regional pool and ensure fallback respects region preferences.
Sara Gomez: UX final ask: add a 'why this route' overlay on the Console trace so SREs can see the decision tree per request.
Priya Patel: Next steps: Alex & Marco to spec API endpoints + schema. Sara to draft console mockups (simulation + trace). Jonah to prototype sliding-window lib. I'll collect and create an RFC.
Alex Chen: I'll start an open PR for /sloProfiles schema. WIP by EOD.
Marco Ruiz: I'll add cb-event webhook enhancements.
infra-bot: note created: RFC-tenant-sla-profiles-2064123456 by Priya Patel.
ops-bot: alert rule suggestion: if >5 tenants open CB in 5m, fire pager to eng-platform.
Priya Patel: thanks everyone — ping me in thread for clarifications. :raised_hands:
